description: Security controls are not being assessed to determine the extent to which they are implemented correctly, operating as intended, and producing the desired outcome. This signal indicates the absence of regular, systematic control assessments that verify the effectiveness of security controls, which is critical for maintaining FedRAMP authorization and ensuring continuous compliance.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies implementing cloud services Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAOs) conducting assessments Federal information systems requiring authorization

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Verify the existence of a documented security assessment plan Check for evidence of regular control assessments (at least annually for FedRAMP) Review security assessment reports for completeness and currency Confirm assessment scope includes all required controls and control enhancements Validate that assessments are conducted by qualified personnel or 3PAOs Examine whether assessment results are properly documented and reported to stakeholders Check for assessment procedures that evaluate control implementation, operation, and effectiveness Verify that assessment findings are tracked and remediated appropriately

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring
